rules.facts: each R line's claim is whole (all parts) in a passage of its named source file in the slice
rules.quote: V1 is verbatim in the July 2026 transcript
rules.T1: the wrong claim is whole in no passage of the slice; the right one is whole in its file
rules.T2: misquote finds the July transcript and names each changed pair
rules.T3: within UNRATE, the wrong figure is whole in no passage and the right one is
rules.T4: the wrong speaker is whole in no passage of its file and the right one is
rules.T5: pair-drift on Hollis's box lists $95.8 billion as in the summary only, and nothing else
rules.calls-made: each call is on its person's record, made before 13:00 UTC on its day
rules.calls-closed: each close comes from the slice's SP500 rows, its day and the trading day before, and its outcome waits on that person's seal
rules.lines: every line in the four folders that names a real figure, rate or official is one of the frozen lines above, word for word
rules.after: no frozen line is dated after today; their own plans may be
rules.stack: Teo's money-hour stack runs on her box, and said finds every quote her minutes keep, with its date
rules.verify: every box's record verifies, and nothing on any of them is sealed
rules.fold: first-mention of tariffs on the folded Fed box is the earliest minutes that say tariff, read directly; the unfolded box's answer is recorded beside it
rules.timeline: Marisol's timeline of the Fed's decisions has each 2023 to 2026 statement's decision line, its raise, lower or maintain the same as the statement's own, and one raise in 2026, on 2026-09-16
rules.sort: every one of the 55 10-Ks is placed by Hollis's themes or named unsorted; none is dropped
rules.thesis: Teo's final letter: every sentence held but T6, which lacks lower; line 2 is held with the 28 October statement among its passages, and the first it names is recorded; her draft is recorded, held or short, sentence by sentence
rules.across: one page across the four people's records: each flagged, with its wager's outcome waiting on its seal
rules.stacks: fed.md on the Fed box and filings.md on the filings box run, and money-hour.md, with its new pools, on Teo's
